_comment: Which fixtures must raise which flags, and which must raise none. The empty lists are the negative controls and they are the more important half of this file: a checker that flags everything passes any suite built only from broken labels. Codes are the exact Finding.code values, and the test asserts set equality rather than containment, so a new false positive on a correct label fails the suite.

expected_notes._comment: Notes that must be present on specific fixtures. A note is not an error, and the tool must still produce it.
